base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_035" || ' ' || T1."XCL_036" AS full_name, T1."XCL_037" AS college
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_022"
WHERE T1."XCL_039" IN ('Medium', 'Large')
  AND (T2."XCL_019" LIKE '%-09-%' OR T2."XCL_019" LIKE '%-10-%')
GROUP BY T1."XCL_034"
HAVING SUM(T2."XCL_020") > 30

  )
